items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I won more fights on 52nd street than Sugar Ray did in the ring.

ctx.x: I say what? Now I know she's got it. I say well I'll being seeing you. So I packed up my bag and I just bought a brand new gabardine top coat, name dropping, from Phil Cromfields Store in New York. And I'm starting out the door and she's hollering, please don't go, please don't go. And like from the bedroom to the living room, we never closed the doors, the glass doors, we always kept them open, those little doors, you know, jammed between the doors, between the rooms, you know the little up lift. She tripped and…

I set my bag down, took off all of my clothes except my shorts, just like I was going in the ring with Sugar Ray (laughter), I tried to kill her. Then I got the whip. I got tired of the whip, I got the brush and started pecking her in

the top of the head with it. She tried to jump out the window, I wouldn't let her. I say come on back here, (laughter). So I left. Every night, she was across the street, please come back, please come back. No good. No good. I played, I'd done what I could do.
